overview_description.description: SparkGift makes it insanely easy to give investments as gifts (stocks and ETFs).  Instead of giving a $50 gift card, you could give $50 of Tesla stock.  They support fractional shares and small dollar gifts.  They are creating an entirely new gift category.  Through investment gifts, they are creating new savers & new investors at scale.

product.name: Give Stocks as a Gift
product.description: A service that allows users to gift stocks or index funds to others, simplifying the process of investing for both new and experienced investors.

product.name: Learn About Money
product.description: Educational content aimed at helping individuals understand financial concepts and investment strategies.

product.name: SparkGift Stock Gift Certificate
product.description: A feature that enables users to purchase and send a stock gift certificate, allowing recipients to set up an investment account and accept the gift.

product.name: Fractional Shares Gifting
product.description: A service that allows users to gift fractional shares of stocks and index funds, starting at $20, with a small fee for the transaction.

product.name: Simplified Investment and Budgeting Guides
product.description: Resources that provide straightforward advice on managing investments and budgets.

product.name: Current Financial Insights
product.description: Up-to-date information and analysis on financial markets and trends.
